summary.text: Josh Jungling is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 35A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Zack Stephenson (D).
He was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Josh Jungling ran for Minnesota House District 35A in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Zack Stephenson, receiving 48.0 percent of the vote to Stephenson's 51.8 percent.
